owner_instruction: Treat discovery round 12 as the final saturation round because additional marginal yield is not worth another sequential round.

fixed_formal_cohort.selection_rule: first 10 records by the frozen OpenAlex seeded-sample rank for each physical query
fixed_formal_cohort.deduplication: union by canonical record_key across queries and with the already reviewed rounds 1-12
fixed_formal_cohort.language_and_eligibility: unchanged title/abstract screening rules; English-only eligibility remains explicit

reporting_requirements: Disclose that round 12 stopped on pragmatic marginal-yield grounds, not the preregistered consecutive dual-zero rule.
Do not label the fixed formal cohort as round 13.
Retain every formal query ID, seeded-sample rank, record identity, and screening disposition.
Do not claim exhaustive retrieval or a true dual-zero endpoint.
